title: Rectangle Area
description: Calculate the total area covered by two rectilinear rectangles in a 2D plane.
pseudocode:
1. area1 = (ax2-ax1) * (ay2-ay1)
2. area2 = (bx2-bx1) * (by2-by1)
3. overlapW = max(0, min(ax2, bx2) - max(ax1, bx1))
4. overlapH = max(0, min(ay2, by2) - max(ay1, by1))
5. return area1 + area2 - (overlapW * overlapH)

steps.note: Calculate area of first rectangle: (0,0) to (2,2) = 4
Calculate area of second rectangle: (1,1) to (3,3) = 4
